Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.

2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 752 (C) of 2019,
instituted for the offence under Section(s) 323,498A,494, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Petitioner is husband of complainant/O.P. No.2.
4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that he is willing to reconcile the issue with his wife.

Counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner will make all genuine efforts to reconcile the issue so that the reconciliation culminates in restoration of matrimonial harmony or one time Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.39674 of 2023(2) dt.19-08-2023 settlement.
5. Learned Counsel for the State does not object to such proposal as long as amicable settlement is reached between the parties.

6. In view of the such submission, since terms of amicable settlement are to be worked out to Amit Kapoor @ Golu vs The State Of Bihar on 19 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94727034/
1 facilitate the same, the Court directs that, till further orders, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with above noted case.

failing which the application shall stand rejected without further reference to a Bench.
8.
Let the parties appear before the District Mediation Centre, Saran at Chapra on or before 04-09-2023.

10. Matter be listed after three months.
